I finished primary school so I can read the labels on the bags, and last year the agro-dealer told me to apply around 50 kg of nitrogen per hectare for good maize. My cousin did that and his harvest was strong, so for my 1.27 hectare plot I will buy improved seed, spread manure from our cows, and get three bags of fertilizer from town. We cannot afford chemicals or irrigation here, so my family will weed by hand and depend on the rains, though I will hire a few extra people for about ten days at harvest when the work is too much.
